## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fǎguān jīng* (T611) is a one-fascicle short meditation sūtra translated by Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 ([竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7)). It presents a brief treatment of the *dharma-anupaśyanā* — the fourth of the four foundations of mindfulness (*satipaṭṭhāna* / *smṛtyupasthāna*).

**Abstract**

A miniature contemplation-sūtra on the *dharma-anupaśyanā* foundation, datable to Dharmarakṣa's translation activity (266–308 CE). The text supplements his fuller meditation translations [KR6i0243](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0243) *Xiūxíng dàodì jīng* (T606) and [KR6i0249](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0249) *Shēnguān jīng* 身觀經 (T612).
